title: Benefit Ledger Accounting Rule — Unused RideLink Value-Added Trips at Year End
content:
This accounting rule states how many Non-Emergency Medical Transportation value-added trips a closing benefit year leaves unused, and what its year-end expiry entry carries.

**Which year.** The year closed is the previous benefit year: the calendar year before the current one.

**Formal clause.** At the close of a benefit year, the unused trips of that year are the trips its allotment load entries carried less the trips its debit entries used, and never fewer than none. Every unused trip of the year expires, so the expiry entry carries all of them.

## Ledger reading

| Ledger entries of the closing year | Role |
|---|---|
| Allotment load entries | Trips carried in, added together |
| Debit entries (one per completed value-added leg) | Trips used, added together |
| Unused trips | Loaded less used, and never below zero |
| Expiry entry | Carries every unused trip |

## Worked examples

*Hypothetical closing years:*

| Trips loaded | Trips debited | Unused trips | Expiry entry carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| 24 | 17 | 7 | 7 |
| 12 | 12 | 0 | 0 |
| 8 | 9 | None (never below zero) | 0 |
| 24 and 4 in two load entries | 10 | 18 | 18 |
